name: 81101 · Alamosa, CO
findings: ZIP 81101 (Alamosa) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81101 (Alamosa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81101 (Alamosa) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
